rationale: This Dutch Raad van State decision concerns emergency administrative enforcement (spoedeisende bestuursdwang) and recovery of costs (€ 131.00) for unlawfully disposing of household solid waste (huishoudelijke afvalstoffen) under the municipal waste ordinance (Afvalstoffenverordening van de gemeente Heerlen 2014). It is a municipal solid waste enforcement dispute unrelated to water law, wastewater/sewage, or water governance.
